name: Midtown Show — Red Curtain
description: First Target Output Profile. A performer on the Midtown Show red-curtain stage: 9:16 canvas, one fixed plate, tracked framing, the Red Curtain grade. Every number here was measured on the archived clips (MIDTOWN_RED_CURTAIN_PIPELINE.md).

framing.note: head_target is a floor: the solve may push the head down to hold the size cap, never up.

look.params: shrink=0.8 feather=1.2 fgsat=1.00 fgcon=1.06 fggamma=1.02 warmr=1.02 warmg=1.00 warmb=0.96 shadr=0.018 shadg=0.004 shadb=0.004 keyfall=0.08 rimamt=0.28 rimr=1.00 rimg=0.42 rimb=0.38 rimdy=-14 rimblur=15 lwamt=0.50 lwwidth=9 bgblur=0 bloom=0.05 vignette=0.10 bgexp=1.00

picture_area.label: Picture area
picture_area.rule: the recorded picture must fill the file; padding is cropped before framing

wardrobe_vs_plate.label: Wardrobe vs plate
wardrobe_vs_plate.note: pre-composite predictor; does not discriminate (archive: 1.44x on a failing clip, 1.38x on a passing one)

headroom.label: Headroom
headroom.unit: fraction of picture height above the crown
headroom.note: recommended is the 5–12 % headroom the recording requirements ask for — guidance, not a gate. crown_visible_min_for_head_metrics is an EVIDENCE-SUFFICIENCY threshold, not a framing-quality threshold: the head-motion verification (head_spread, head_drift) reads the matte's top, and where the crown is cut that top is a completed crown at best and the picture edge at worst — an edge that cannot move and so reports a stillness that was never measured. Below this fraction of frames with a recorded crown, Stage Ready does not have enough genuine evidence to trust the head metrics: the finding fails and a reshoot is required. Between it and crown_visible_pass the finding warns and verification may proceed. 0.5 is a conservative operational threshold based on that mechanism (the performer's own uncut frames must be the norm, so the crown completion has references throughout and the head metrics measure a recorded crown on most frames); it is not a scientifically validated framing threshold. crown_visible_pass carries the former hardcoded 5 %-of-frames warning into the profile.

key_direction.label: Key direction
key_direction.note: measured, then matched by the grade; below 1.08 the room is flat-lit

gates.label: Crown evidence for the head metrics
gates.unit: fraction of frames with the crown inside the picture
gates.note: the same evidence-sufficiency rule as inspection.headroom, enforced at verification so no render passes the head metrics on a stable crop edge

strategies.label: Crop to picture area + size-capped reframe
Separation-targeted composite
strategies.note: Stronger rim and light wrap, a bounded shadow lift. Changes the edge, never the performer's pixels.

reshoot_guidance.picture_area: Export without padding: send the recorded picture, not a letterboxed or pillarboxed file.
reshoot_guidance.subject_size: Stand 2–3 m from the camera and frame head to mid-thigh. A close-up cannot be zoomed out of.
reshoot_guidance.distance_steady: Be at your final distance before the take starts. Do not walk toward or away from the camera.
reshoot_guidance.pose_coverage: Be fully in frame, standing, for the whole take.
reshoot_guidance.one_subject: Nobody else in shot — no mirrors, screens, glass or person-shaped things behind you.
reshoot_guidance.matte_extent: Give your hair 12 % headroom and stand 1 m off a plain wall.
reshoot_guidance.separation: Don't wear the stage. The curtain is deep red: no red, maroon, burgundy or hot pink. Mid-tone neutrals, blue, green or a pattern separate by about 3x.
reshoot_guidance.face_exposure: One large soft light in front of you at eye level; the face must be clearly lit.
reshoot_guidance.head_spread: Lock the camera off on a tripod; no auto-reframe, no digital stabilisation.
reshoot_guidance.head_drift: Lock the camera off on a tripod; no auto-reframe, no digital stabilisation.
reshoot_guidance.headroom: Leave 5–12 % of the frame height above your hair, measured when you stand up straight: a crown the camera never recorded cannot be verified, and cannot be put back.
reshoot_guidance.crown_visible: Leave 5–12 % of the frame height above your hair, measured when you stand up straight: a crown the camera never recorded cannot be verified, and cannot be put back.
